description: Formation of a vehicular access to the front of the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (PP/VCO/465/2 (received 26/01/2021); PP/VCO/465/1/REVA (received 17/03/2021); &  PP/VCO/465/3/REVA (received 31/03/2021)) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - 	Notwithstanding the details shown on the plans hereby approved the area of hardstanding shall be no more than 3m in width with soft landscaping provided to either side of the parking space and a separate 1.2m wide pedestrian footpath shall have been provided to facilitate access to the front door prior to first use of the vehicle crossover.
Condition : 4 - Prior to first use of the crossover hereby permitted the 600mm high front boundary wall shown on the plans hereby approved shall have been erected and thereafter maintained as such
